Class DynamicTester

java.lang.Object
main.Tester<DynamicTestcase>
main.dynamic.DynamicTester
public class DynamicTester extends Tester<DynamicTestcase>
An implementation of the Tester with dynamic testcases to simplify the dynamic testing
